metadata.verification_command: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest -q; PYTHONPATH=. python3 tests/deep_eval.py
metadata.evidence_boundary: offline synthetic fixtures and local deterministic verifier; not production or live-provider evidence

requirements.evidence: Deterministic context telemetry is covered by tests and the 40-case deep evaluation.
Ambiguous proxy actions return PAUSED before execution; covered by tests/test_core.py and executor tests.
Risky actions transition through an attributable reviewer checkpoint; covered by auth, webhook, and guardrail tests.
tests/benchmark.py reports baseline 0/10 and solution 10/10 unsafe actions caught on its 12-case fixture.
tests/deep_eval.py reports 40/40 classifications correct and local p50/p95 guard latency of approximately 41.5/46.7 ms; the historical 25 ms p95 target is not met by this recorded run.
FastAPI contract and payload boundary work; production provider forwarding and deployment authentication remain target-environment work.
Declared stdio tools work, but the adapter is a lightweight JSON transport rather than the official MCP SDK protocol.
SDK tests verify safe functions proceed and paused functions are not invoked.
Root SKILL.md requires structured proposals, guard-first behavior, and stop-on-pause handling.
Trajectory persistence and reviewer attribution are covered by the checkpoint, auth, audit, and durability tests; no generated runtime trajectory is cited as repository evidence.
Guardrail tests verify fast routing for low-risk actions and escalated routing for consequential or high-context actions.
Generic OpenAI-compatible and bounded retry provider boundaries are implemented and tested locally; approved live provider runs are not measured.
Reviewer approval and rejection routes are implemented in honest_agent/interfaces/webhooks.py and covered by auth/durability tests.
Token telemetry is deterministic and repeatable but uses a documented regex approximation rather than a model-specific tokenizer.

summary.interpretation: Local evaluation is healthy; deployment-dependent production controls remain outside this result file.
